venue.name: Sindhu Sadan
venue.address: 9FVH+65G, Hira Hall, Beside Luminous One Continent Hotel, King Koti Road, BogulKunta Road, Abids, Hyderabad, Telangana

items.information:
All the participants are expected to volunteer in the competition and every participant (except the New comers) will be assigned to a particular event that they have to Judge (or) Scramble in which they are participating. 
All the staff/volunteering assignments will be decided by the organising team and participants will be informed of the same 2 days prior to the event, we will ensure that your volunteering does not affect your events.

**ALL PARTICIPANTS HAVE TO BE AT THE VENUE ATLEAST 40 MINUTES BEFORE THE START OF THEIR EVENT. LATE COMERS WILL NOT BE ALLOWED TO PARTICIPATE.**

Please check out all the tabs for additional important information.

items.name: Imagination Station B 2027

venue.name: [Imagination Station](https://www.imaginationstationtoledo.org/)
venue.details: Exploration Center - on the lower floor next to the cafeteria

items.information:
This competition is at the Imagination Station science center. Non-competing family members and spectators are **required to purchase general admission** to the science center to enter the competition. Competitors will pick up their lanyards at the front desk and will not need to purchase general admission.

Imagination Station opens at 12pm - you will not be able to get in earlier.
